directionsRead: Pānuitia ia whakaaturanga, ka kōwhiri ai i tāu e mahi ai.
directionsEndings: He maha ngā mutunga. Whakamātauria he ara kē ina oti koe.
scenesSeen: Kua kitea te {seen} o ngā whakaaturanga {total}
newSceneText: Whakaahuatia te mea ka puta, kātahi ka hono i ia kōwhiringa ki tētahi whakaaturanga.
editingNote: Whakatika: ka whakaaturia ngā whakaaturanga katoa. He hono te kōwhiringa ki te # me te ID whakaaturanga i muri.
noScenes: Tāpirihia he whakaaturanga hei tīmata i te tauwhāiti.
